turns.customer: I changed my mind about order #1056. Can I return it?
turns.reply: Order #1056 hasn't been delivered yet, so a return can't be started right now. Once your Traverse 65 Trekking Pack arrives, unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery using the return label in your account. The warehouse will issue your refund once they receive it!
